Name: Nyapu Style Seasonal Adventure's Guild Expanded
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adventure's Guild Expanded Seasonal is finally done! There were a couple of Seasonal AGE mods out there... I chose CakeyBunz mods because their Spirit festival outfits were included and there was a DSV option. I have to admit, some of the edits were challenging. Especially Zinnia. But I think the Nyapu retextures turned out pretty good. I think their festival outfits are my fav. I had some issues making the CP code... so I am crossing my fingers it works without bugs. This one has a bunch of requirements. Sorry about that, but there was no easy way to condense these mods together. I hope you all like it![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[Main File] CP is just a drag-and-drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go. 
GABRIEL AND ZINNA ETHNICITY IS SET TO MONGOLIAN.
TO CHANGE THEM BACK TO VANILLA YOU NEED TO GO TO GMCM OPTIONS:
[list]
[*] (CP) Seasonal Adventures Guild Expanded Nyapu Style - Changes their portraits[/*]
[*]CakeyBunz Gabriel Retexture -Changes Gabriel's sprites[/*]
[*]CakeyBunz Zinnia Retexture - Changes Zinnia's Sprites[/*]
[/list]
[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
All of these mods are Required
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22591]Adventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6[/url] 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25050]AGE Gabriel Retextured (Seasonal)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24075]AGE Zinnia Retextured (Seasonal)[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
The thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for teaching me how to code. [/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68561073]LiveOnSUPERT[/url]  and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120600468]laureic[/url]  for making and maintain AGE.[/i]
[i]Thank you   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/105284748]CakeyBunz[/url]  for allowing me to retexture your designs. Your outfit ideas were awesome.[/i]
[i]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your living portrait frame edit.  [/i][/color]
